the early signaling pathway in the Arabidopsis innate immunity system, which is triggered by the recognition of conserved microbe-associated molecular pattern molecules by pattern recognition receptors.
the molecular basis of plant defense responses against pathogens, which is one of the most important issues in modern plant biology.
the elucidation of early signaling events that lead to the activation of the plant innate immune response.
